title: BENCHMARKING MLLM-BASED WEB UNDERSTANDING: REASONING, ROBUSTNESS AND SAFETY
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in the context of web understanding, specifically looking at reasoning, robustness to UI perturbations, and functional safety (such as identifying buttons that lead to irreversible actions like account deletion). It does not investigate religion, faith, morals, or philosophical ethics.
